annotations.title: Verify Post-Payment x402 Delivery & Mint SLA Receipt

description: Audit a paid x402 or A2A provider after payment to confirm delivery or prove an SLA breach with an HMAC-SHA256 signed receipt. Passing status_code >= 500 forces verdict='sla_breach_confirmed' even if the live re-probe succeeds, while passing tx_hash cryptographically binds your Base or Solana payment signature into the receipt (omitting tx_hash still verifies liveness and issues a probe-bound receipt). Non-destructive; first 5 calls/IP are free and failed target connections do not throw tool errors. Use only after paying a provider; before payment use assay_preflight; for public indexing use assay_probe; for policy history use assay_get_ledger_policy. Example: target='https://agentdiet-72343955726.us-central1.run.app/mcp'.

status_code.description: Optional HTTP status code returned by the paid endpoint (e.g. '200', '502', '504'). Codes >= 500 force verdict='sla_breach_confirmed' even if a retry probe succeeds.

target.description: Public HTTPS URL of the remote MCP server, A2A agent, or x402 endpoint to inspect (e.g. 'https://tandem.ac/mcp'). Private and loopback IPs are blocked.

tx_hash.description: Optional on-chain payment transaction hash (0x Base USDC hash or base58 Solana signature) to bind into the signed SLA receipt. Omit to run an unsigned post-call SLA check.
